design_description: A refined Box FC design rooted in Les Grottes, Geneva, using a warm cream base with deep burgundy detailing for a restrained, heritage-inspired identity. The lower section features a finely illustrated Geneva landscape, combining the mountains, lake and urban waterfront into a continuous panoramic scene that anchors the shirt geographically. A very subtle tonal organic pattern appears across the upper body, adding depth without competing with the clean central OCB sponsor or Box FC crest. Burgundy is used consistently across the branding, sponsor and sleeve graphics, including custom Grottes-inspired marks that reinforce the local storytelling. Overall, it feels like a neighbourhood jersey rather than a generic football template: understated from distance, but filled with Geneva and Grottes references when viewed up close.
